fields.title: Editing Your Program's Name
fields.highlights: How to change your SaaSquatch program name after it is created.
fields.content: > This guide only covers how to change the display name of your SaaSquatch program. To change your Program ID, please contact the Support Team. 1. Head to the 'Programs' tab in your SaaSquatch tenant. ![Programs Tab](//images.ctfassets.net/s68ib1kj8k5n/5OfWSAU0kyXdYBL8UwT8aF/7089b60b7ab9919a9f8de8c01bf67d3c/Screenshot_2021-03-05_1.28.05_PM.png) 2. Click on "Manage" under the sub-navigation. 3. Once you have located the program you want to rename, click on the pencil icon to the right-hand side of the program's name. ![Manage Programs](//images.ctfassets.net/s68ib1kj8k5n/2bHeJleIn8kUCg75eqz2Zp/4836c0769fbb45d3d44d4626db5c7dbe/Screenshot_2021-03-05_1.31.36_PM.png) 3. You should now be able to modify the disaply name of your program. ![Edit Program Name](//images.ctfassets.net/s68ib1kj8k5n/6FSxSixYabYiuatD19GYH5/c9c7525a2548649a0ddeb87b898dde19/Screenshot_2021-03-05_1.33.30_PM.png) 4. Click on the orange checkmark button to save your edits. ![Program Name Edited](//images.ctfassets.net/s68ib1kj8k5n/LVJ7PJBU6ACoSJuW9iSBB/96af37bf7799091afce731df2a63bc76/Screenshot_2021-03-05_1.37.54_PM.png)
